title: EmailComparator keyword constraint not enforced at type level
description: RFC 8621 §4.4.2: when property is 'hasKeyword', 'allInThreadHaveKeyword', or 'someInThreadHaveKeyword', the Comparator MUST also have a keyword field. EmailComparator has keyword: Option<String> but no enforcement. A comparator with property='hasKeyword' and keyword=None is logically invalid per RFC but accepted silently. Should add a validate() method or custom Deserialize that enforces this, or at minimum document the constraint clearly in the field doc.
